name: Warm German Red Potato Salad — Bacon and Vinegar
sub: Red potatoes · 4 side servings · estimated macros
text:
Warm bacon-and-vinegar version; German potato salads vary by region.

INGREDIENTS
1½ lb red potatoes, scrubbed, skins on
4 regular-cut strips bacon
1 tbsp reserved bacon drippings
½ cup finely diced onion
¼ cup plus 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
¼ cup water
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
2 tsp sugar
2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
Salt and black pepper to taste

METHOD
1. Cover whole potatoes with cold water. Bring to a gentle boil and simmer 15–25 minutes, depending on size, until just fork-tender.
2. Drain; when cool enough to handle, slice into ¼-inch rounds.
3. Fry bacon until crisp, remove, and crumble. Keep exactly 1 tbsp drippings in skillet; remove the rest. The reserved drippings come from the bacon, not additional purchased fat.
4. Cook onion in reserved drippings over medium heat for 4–5 minutes.
5. Stir in vinegar, water, mustard, sugar, and black pepper; simmer 1–2 minutes.
6. Gently fold in warm potatoes; keep over low heat 2–3 minutes as dressing soaks in.
7. Fold in bacon and parsley. Taste before salting. Rest 10 minutes; serve warm.

ESTIMATED MACROS
Per ¼ batch: 214 kcal · 6.6 g protein · 31.6 g carbs · 7.0 g fat · 3.4 g fiber.
Whole batch: 855 kcal · 26.4 g protein · 126.3 g carbs · 27.8 g fat.
Includes cooked bacon plus 1 tbsp retained drippings and 2 tsp sugar.

NUTRITION STATUS
Generic estimates saved from conversation, October 25, 2026; not calculated from saved brand labels. Each recipe makes 4 side servings. A serving is ¼ of the finished batch, not a fixed weight. Brand, bacon size, and optional ingredients affect totals.
Refrigerate leftovers and use within 3–4 days.
